draft.emotion: comfortably cozy and relaxed, enjoying a gentle heat
notes: Describes a pleasant, mild warmth (like warm water or food), unlike ร้อน (rɔ́ːn, hot). Often reduplicated as อุ่นๆ (warmish, nice and warm).
Also used as a verb meaning 'to warm up' or 'to reheat' food (e.g. อุ่นอาหาร).

senses.definition: Having a pleasant, mild temperature between cool and hot.
